businessModel: Free browser tied to the VK/Mail.ru ecosystem (search, services and promotions); discontinued, so no active monetization
updateCadence: None since 2024; last known build dates from 2023
summary: Atom was a Chromium-based browser launched by Mail.ru Group in 2019 with a built-in ad blocker, Kaspersky file checks and VK services integration. VK ended downloads and updates in Sept 2024, so it no longer gets security fixes.
bestFor: Nobody for new use; it receives no security updates
Historical reference for VK and Mail.ru's browser efforts
notFor: Anyone browsing the open web, since the frozen Chromium base is unpatched
Users who need working sync or support
Privacy-minded users, given VK telemetry and promotions
Those who want a maintained Chromium alternative (see alternatives)

pros.title: Built-in ad blocker
pros.detail: Atom shipped with an ad blocker and anti-tracking features without extensions.

pros.title: Kaspersky file checks
pros.detail: Since May 2019 it checked downloads against Kaspersky Online File Reputation.

pros.title: Chrome Web Store extensions
pros.detail: As a Chromium browser it supported Chrome extensions and imports from other browsers.

pros.title: VK integration
pros.detail: Visual bookmarks and VK/Mail.ru services were built into the start page.

cons.title: Discontinued
cons.detail: VK stopped downloads and updates after Sept 13, 2024, and the official site no longer works.

cons.title: Unpatched engine
cons.detail: The Chromium base is frozen at the last build, so known browser vulnerabilities stay open.

cons.title: Sync no longer reliable
cons.detail: User reports say account sync stopped working after the shutdown.

cons.title: VK promotions and telemetry
cons.detail: A Russian review site lists VK promotions and telemetry as part of the product.

faq.a: No. VK said downloads and updates would end on Sept 13, 2024, and the official site browser.ru is offline.

faq.q: Is it safe to keep using Atom?
faq.a: No. The Chromium base has had no security patches since the last build, so switching to a maintained browser is advised.
VK named no replacement; Yandex Browser, Opera, Firefox or a current Chromium browser are the usual choices.

timeline.event: Mail.ru Group announces Atom for Windows, based on Chromium, with a 1 million ruble bug bounty
Kaspersky Online File Reputation added for download checks
VK ends downloads and updates (Sept 13); official site goes offline

switching.note: Export bookmarks and passwords locally; sync servers are reported as no longer working, so cloud restore is unlikely.
